1.text: “Ntimuhagarike imitima yanyu, mwizere Imana nanjye munyizere.

2.text: Mu rugo rwa Data harimo amazu menshi: iyaba adahari mba mbabwiye, kuko ngiye kubategurira ahanyu.

3.text: Kandi ubwo ngiye kubategurira ahanyu, nzagaruka mbajyane iwanjye, ngo aho ndi namwe muzabeyo.

5.text: Toma aramubwira ati “Databuja, ntituzi aho ujya, inzira twayibwirwa n'iki?”

6.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Ni jye nzira n'ukuri n'ubugingo: nta wujya kwa Data ntamujyanye.

7.text: Iyaba mwaramenye, muba mwaramenye na Data. Uhereye none muramuzi kandi mwamurebye.”

8.text: Filipo aramubwira ati “Databuja, twereke Data wa twese biraba bihagije.”

9.text: Yesu aramubaza ati “Nabanye namwe iminsi ingana ityo, kandi ntiwari wamenya, Filipo? Umbonye aba abonye Data. Ni iki gitumye uvuga uti ‘Twereke Data wa twese’?

10.text: Ntiwizeye yuko ndi muri Data, na Data akaba ari muri jye? Amagambo mbabwira sinyavuga ku bwanjye, ahubwo Data uguma muri jye ni we ukora imirimo ye.

11.text: Nimunyizere mwemere ko ndi muri Data, na Data akaba muri jye, ariko rero nimutizezwa n'ibyo mvuga, munyizezwe n'imirimo nkora ubwayo.

12.text: Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko unyizera, imirimo nkora na we azayikora ndetse azakora n'iyiruta, kuko njya kwa Data.

13.text: Kandi icyo muzasaba cyose mu izina ryanjye, nzagikorera kugira ngo Data yubahirizwe mu Mwana we.

14.text: Nimugira icyo musaba cyose mu izina ryanjye nzagikora.

16.text: Nanjye nzasaba Data, na we azabaha undi Mufasha wo kubana namwe ibihe byose,

17.text: ni we Mwuka w'ukuri. Ntibishoboka ko ab'isi bamuhabwa, kuko batamurora kandi batamuzi, ariko mwebweho muramuzi kuko abana namwe, kandi azaba muri mwe.

19.text: Hasigaye umwanya muto ab'isi ntibabe bakimbona, ariko mwebweho muzambona, kuko ndiho namwe muzabaho.

20.text: Uwo munsi muzamenya ko ndi muri Data namwe mukaba muri jye, nanjye nkaba muri mwe.

21.text: “Ufite amategeko yanjye akayitondera ni we unkunda, kandi unkunda azakundwa na Data, nanjye nzamukunda mwiyereke.”

22.text: Yuda utari Isikariyota aramubaza ati “Databuja, bibaye bite ko ugiye kutwiyereka ntiwiyereke ab'isi?”

23.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Umuntu nankunda azitondera ijambo ryanjye, na Data azamukunda, tuzaza aho ari tugumane na we.

24.text: Ariko utankunda ntiyitondera amagambo yanjye, kandi iryo jambo mwumvise si iryanjye, ahubwo ni irya Data wantumye.

26.text: ariko Umufasha ari we Mwuka Wera, uwo Data azatuma mu izina ryanjye ni we uzabigisha byose, abibutse ibyo nababwiye byose.

27.text: “Mbasigiye amahoro, amahoro yanjye ndayabahaye. Icyakora simbaha nk'uko ab'isi batanga. Imitima yanyu ntihagarare kandi ntitinye.

28.text: Mwumvise uko nababwiye nti ‘Ndagenda kandi nzagaruka aho muri.’ Iyaba mwankundaga, muba munejejwe n'uko njya kwa Data kuko Data anduta.

29.text: Nuko rero mbibabwiye bitaraba, ngo ubwo bizaba muzizere.

30.text: Sinkivugana namwe byinshi, kuko umutware w'ab'iyi si aza kandi nta cyo amfiteho,

31.text: ahubwo nkora uko Data yantegetse, kugira ngo ab'isi bamenye ko munkunda.“Nimuhaguruke tuve hano.
